evidence.notes: List async insert accepts an Object-typed callback plus AccessLevel and invokes the save callback.
Single-record async insert accepts an Object-typed callback plus AccessLevel and returns a SaveResult.
List async update accepts an Object-typed callback plus AccessLevel and invokes the save callback.
Single-record async update accepts an Object-typed callback plus AccessLevel and returns a SaveResult.
List async delete accepts an Object-typed callback plus AccessLevel and invokes the delete callback.
Single-record async delete accepts an Object-typed callback plus AccessLevel and returns a DeleteResult.

source.content: public class AsyncObjectSaveProbe implements DataSource.AsyncSaveCallback { public static Integer calls = 0; public void processSave(Database.SaveResult result) { if (result != null && result.isSuccess()) { calls++; } } }

public class AsyncObjectDeleteProbe implements DataSource.AsyncDeleteCallback { public static Integer calls = 0; public void processDelete(Database.DeleteResult result) { if (result != null && result.isSuccess()) { calls++; } } }

@isTest private class AsyncDatabaseObjectCallbackAccessLevelTest { @isTest static void objectCallbackAccessLevelOverloadsRunLocalDml() { Object saveCallback = new AsyncObjectSaveProbe(); Database.SaveResult singleInsert = Database.insertAsync(new Account(Name = 'single insert'), saveCallback, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(singleInsert.isSuccess()); List<SObject> listInsertRows = new List<SObject>{new Account(Name = 'list insert one'), new Account(Name = 'list insert two')}; List<Database.SaveResult> listInserted = Database.insertAsync(listInsertRows, saveCallback, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, listInserted.size()); System.assertEquals(3, AsyncObjectSaveProbe.calls); Database.SaveResult singleUpdate = Database.updateAsync(new Account(Id = singleInsert.getId(), Name = 'single updated'), saveCallback, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(singleUpdate.isSuccess()); List<SObject> listUpdateRows = new List<SObject>{new Account(Id = listInserted.get(0).getId(), Name = 'list updated one'), new Account(Id = listInserted.get(1).getId(), Name = 'list updated two')}; System.assertEquals(2, Database.updateAsync(listUpdateRows, saveCallback, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); System.assertEquals(6, AsyncObjectSaveProbe.calls); Object deleteCallback = new AsyncObjectDeleteProbe(); Database.DeleteResult singleDeleted = Database.deleteAsync(new Account(Id = singleInsert.getId()), deleteCallback, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(singleDeleted.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(2, Database.deleteAsync(listUpdateRows, deleteCallback, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); System.assertEquals(3, AsyncObjectDeleteProbe.calls); } }
